_comment: Generated by tools/mutation_gate.py --rebaseline. Do not edit mutants/summary by hand; the gate cross-checks them. Add a written reason for every survivor under survivor_reasons.

survivor_reasons.nmtccalc/models/investor.py::_compute_ir: EQUIVALENT unless the root lies within 1e-9 of -100%: moves the lower bracket from -1+1e-9 to -1-1e-9; bisection midpoints stay above the root for every vector whose inflows exceed ~1e-7 of the outflow. Solver safety bound, not a modeled figure.
EQUIVALENT: bracket expansion 'while NPV(hi) > 0' vs '>= 0' differs only when NPV(hi) is exactly 0, where both converge to the same root hi.
EQUIVALENT: hi starts at 1.0 and doubles, so it is a power of two and never equals 1e9; '> 1e9' and '>= 1e9' select the same iterations.
EQUIVALENT: bisection branch on NPV(mid) > 0 vs >= 0 differs only when NPV(mid) is exactly 0, i.e. mid is the root; both keep the root inside the bracket.

EQUIVALENT: stopping at hi-lo < tol vs <= tol changes the stop by at most one bisection step at 1e-12; every IRR assertion against a literal is abs=1e-10 or coarser; the one abs=1e-12 IRR assertion (tests/test_labels.py) compares two IRRs from the same solver, which this mutant moves together.
EQUIVALENT: initial upper bracket 1.0 vs 1.1; any hi with NPV(hi) <= 0 brackets the unique root of a single-outflow-then-inflows vector.

UNREACHABLE in practice via the public API: moves the solver's refusal cap (IRR above ~1e9, i.e. 1e11 %). investor.analyze reaches such an IRR only for a credit price within about 3e-10 of 0.05/0.39 (measured: +3e-10 gives IRR 4.27e8 and computes; +1e-10 exceeds the cap and returns None), where the t=0 flow is a fraction of a cent. Safety bound, not a modeled figure.
EQUIVALENT: lower-bracket offset from -100% of 1e-9 vs 1.1e-9; differs only for a root within ~1e-9 of -100%.

EQUIVALENT at test precision: bisection tolerance 1e-12 vs 1.1e-12; every IRR assertion against a literal is abs=1e-10 or coarser; the one abs=1e-12 IRR assertion (tests/test_labels.py) compares two IRRs from the same solver, which this mutant moves together.
EQUIVALENT: bracket growth factor 2.0 vs 2.2; any factor > 1 reaches an hi with NPV(hi) <= 0 and the bisection then converges to the same unique root.
EQUIVALENT: max_iter 500 vs 501; the tolerance break fires after 41-44 iterations (measured on the sample deal's flows, [-100,110], [-1,10], [-100,0.5]), so the cap is never reached.
